description: Defines cuDNN descriptor classes and utility functions for CUDA tensor operations within PyTorch's ATen library, including descriptors for RNNs, tensors, filters, convolutions, dropout, and activation functions.

classes.name: Descriptor
classes.description: A generic wrapper for cuDNN descriptor types, managing creation, destruction, and access.

classes.name: RNNDataDescriptor
classes.description: Descriptor for cuDNN RNN data, setting tensor layout and sequence info.

classes.name: TensorDescriptor
classes.description: Descriptor for cuDNN tensors, including setting sizes, strides, and broadcasting.

classes.name: FilterDescriptor
classes.description: Descriptor for cuDNN filters, including setting filter sizes and formats.

classes.name: ConvolutionDescriptor
classes.description: Descriptor for convolution operations, including padding, stride, and math type.

classes.name: DropoutDescriptor
classes.description: Descriptor for dropout layers, managing RNG state and dropout parameters.

classes.name: RNNDescriptor
classes.description: Descriptor for RNN layers, including dropout, input size, and algorithm settings.

classes.name: CTCLossDescriptor
classes.description: Descriptor for CTC loss, including setting normalization and propagation modes.

classes.name: ActivationDescriptor
classes.description: Descriptor for activation functions, currently supporting ReLU.

classes.name: Constant
classes.description: Union for holding constant float or double values, used in cuDNN operations.

methods.name: cudnnTypeToString
methods.description: Converts cuDNN data type enum to string.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Various overloads for setting descriptor parameters for RNN data, tensors, filters, convolutions, etc.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints descriptor details (for TensorDescriptor and FilterDescriptor).

methods.name: set_no_dropout
methods.description: Sets DropoutDescriptor to have no dropout.
